title: Pilates With Angelina

services.name: Me & Pilates
services.desc: Pilates is a safe, intelligent exercise modality known to help you move, look, and feel your very best. You will gain body awareness, Improve posture, develop grace and ease of movement. Practicing Pilates also improves pain symptoms, range of motion, stability, agility and movement efficiency. My studio is fully equipped with Pilates Apparatus to help us perform the repertoire correctly and efficiently.Pilates is for EVERYONE. No matter your age, fitness level, body type or gender. I teach Pilates from a somatic, trauma, and nervous system informed lens based on the poly-vagal theory.To spare a long explanation, this means addressing your whole being. This means slowing down and focusing
